# action.docker_service_force_update

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Redeploys every task of a swarm service without changing its spec, like `docker service update --force`. The rollout follows the service's update_config. It bumps TaskTemplate.ForceUpdate; a `docker_service` that leaves `force_update` unset ignores the new value.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_service_force_update.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_service_force_update" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_service_force_update.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_service_force_update.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | `string` | required |  |  | Service ID or name. |
| `timeout` | `string` | optional |  |  | How long to wait for convergence, as a Go duration. Default `5m`. |
| `wait` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wait until the service converges (every wanted task running). Default `true`. |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_swarm_node" "worker2" {
  host            = "tcp://10.0.0.7:2376"
  join_token      = var.worker_join_token
  manager_address = "10.0.0.5:2377"

  # Swarm does not move running tasks onto a new node by itself: redeploy
  # the service once the node has joined so tasks spread over it.
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_service_force_update.web]
    }
  }
}

variable "worker_join_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Redeploys every task without changing the spec. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_service_force_update.web
action "docker_service_force_update" "web" {
  config {
    service = "web"
    timeout = "10m"
  }
}
```
